editorial:
Imagine being terrified of hospitals and then having to enter one to save the person you love. That is exactly the nightmare you get into here. You follow a teacher who has a huge fear of medical buildings, but she has to go inside to find her missing boyfriend. While she is wandering the halls, she meets another guy who is going through the same scary situation. The vibe is very tense and makes you feel like something is always watching you from around the corner, turning a normal hospital into a scary maze.

The acting is solid and the way the tension builds up keeps you glued to your seat. Some parts might feel a bit slow, but the twists at the end make the wait worth it. If you enjoy movies that play with your mind, you should definitely give this one a shot. For the best experience, try renting it on Apple TV or streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the creepy details. If you are a big fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a great way to keep this thriller forever.
endingExplained: You find out that the hospital is not a real place in the physical world. It is actually a sort of purgatory for people who are in a coma. The main characters are fighting for their lives in the real world, and the scary things they see are reflections of their trauma. In the end, the teacher manages to wake up from her coma and return to reality, leaving the nightmare of Room 6 behind her.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological puzzles and hospital horror.
